summary: Tirupati International Airport (IATA: TIR, ICAO: VOTP) is located at Renigunta, about 15 km from Tirupati city in Andhra Pradesh, India. It mainly serves pilgrims visiting the Tirumala Venkateswara Temple and is operated by the Airports Authority of India. The airport has a modern passenger terminal and a long runway that accommodates narrow-body domestic jets and limited international traffic.
faqs:
Q: Where is Tirupati International Airport located?
A: It is in Renigunta, about 15 km from Tirupati city center in Andhra Pradesh, India.

Q: How far is the airport from Tirumala Temple?
A: The airport is roughly 30–35 km from Tirumala; travel time varies with traffic and ghat road conditions.

Q: Which airlines fly to Tirupati?
A: Several Indian carriers operate domestic routes to cities such as Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, and Mumbai; international services are limited and can change, so check with airlines.

Q: Does the airport have international flights?
A: Tirupati has international airport status, but it primarily handles domestic flights; any international routes are limited and should be verified before booking.
transport_tips: Prepaid taxis and auto-rickshaws are available outside arrivals, and APSRTC buses connect the airport with Tirupati city and Renigunta railway station. App-based cabs can be limited, so booking a prepaid taxi or arranging a hotel pickup is often more reliable. Allow extra time during pilgrimage peaks, as road traffic to Tirumala and Tirupati can be heavy.
local_tip: Frequent visitors pre-book return transport and arrive at least 90 minutes before departure during Brahmotsavam, weekends, and festival season, when the small terminal gets crowded and taxi queues lengthen.
